findings.description: The new `params` argument is never forwarded to `self.request`, so GET query parameters are silently dropped.
findings.rationale: Calling `session.get(url, params={"page": 2})` now binds the dictionary to the explicit `params` parameter instead of leaving it in `kwargs`. Since the request call forwards only `kwargs`, the server receives no `page` query parameter and may return the wrong results. Forward `params=params` to preserve existing keyword behavior and support the new positional argument.
